This page links every course material. Begin with the [syllabus](syllabus/syllabus.html), which sets out the learning outcomes and the suggested route through the modules. The [README](README.md) explains installation, file organisation and the order in which to run the R scripts.

All examples use **simulated** data from fictional studies. The results illustrate the methods and are not empirical findings.

## Modules

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
mods <- data.frame(
  n = sprintf("%02d", 0:13),
  slug = c("refresher", "foundations", "data-preparation", "traditional-methods",
           "linear-mixed-models", "covariance-models", "interpretation-prediction",
           "gee", "glmm", "time-varying-nonlinear", "missing-data", "diagnostics",
           "planning-reporting", "advanced"),
  title = c("Foundations refresher: R and regression", "Foundations of longitudinal data",
            "Preparing and exploring longitudinal data in R",
            "Statistical foundations and traditional approaches",
            "Linear mixed-effects models", "Modelling covariance and choosing a model",
            "Interpretation, contrasts and prediction", "Generalized estimating equations",
            "Generalized linear mixed models", "Time-varying predictors and nonlinear change",
            "Missing data and dropout", "Diagnostics and troubleshooting",
            "Study planning, reporting and reproducibility", "Advanced extensions"),
  level = c("Core (optional refresher)", rep("Core", 12), "Advanced")
)
pa <- c("02", "04", "06", "08", "10")
cat("| Module | Level | Notes | Slides | Workbook | Answer key | Knowledge check | Practical |\n")
cat("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mods))) {
  m <- mods[i, ]; s <- paste0(m$n, "-", m$slug)
  prac <- if (m$n %in% pa) sprintf("[pa%s](assessments/pa%s.html)", m$n, s) else ""
  cat(sprintf("| **%d. %s** | %s | [notes](notes/%s.html) | [slides](slides/%s-slides.html) | [wb%s](workbook/wb%s.html) | [ak%s](answer-key/ak%s.html) | [kc%s](assessments/kc%s.html) | %s |\n",
              as.integer(m$n), m$title, m$level, s, s, m$n, s, m$n, s, m$n, s, prac))
}
```
